title: Mixed reactions to clever features and cruising refinement
summary: This topic combines comments about clever but sometimes overcomplicated features, isolated build and driving impressions, and one clear note of praise for overall feel.

positive.summary: Positive feedback says the car feels good overall, with one comparison to a more premium driving feel.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined comments mention quiet cruising, clever or useful features, but also remarks about complexity, weak feature usefulness, flimsy panels, and a boring drive.

limitations: Most supplied examples are undetermined, so clear sentiment direction is limited.
